description: Dashboard, individual matching, and match detail pages: Dashboard with overview cards, match list with compatibility scores and reasons, match detail with full breakdown and conversation starter, match actions (save/skip/chat).
steps: Create src/app/(main)/dashboard/page.tsx - Dashboard page showing: welcome message with user name, top 3 match previews (avatar, name, compatibility %), recommended pod preview card, upcoming event card, quick stats (total matches, pods joined, unread messages). Use shadcn Card components with clean grid layout.
Create src/components/dashboard/match-preview-card.tsx - Compact match card showing avatar, name, major, compatibility percentage with color-coded badge (green >80%, yellow >60%, orange otherwise).
Create src/components/dashboard/pod-preview-card.tsx - Pod preview with title, member count, type badge, and compatibility score.
Create src/components/dashboard/event-preview-card.tsx - Event preview with name, date, location, and attendee count.
Create src/components/dashboard/stats-bar.tsx - Quick stats row with icon + number pairs.

Create src/app/(main)/matches/page.tsx - Matches list page showing all compatible students sorted by score descending. Each card shows: avatar, name, major/year, compatibility percentage, top 3 match reasons as badges, shared classes count, shared interests count, action buttons (View, Save, Skip, Chat). Include empty state for no matches.

Create src/components/matches/match-card.tsx - Full match card component with all the above fields. Use the calculateMatchScore function from lib/matching to compute scores dynamically against the current user's profile.
Create src/components/matches/match-reason-badge.tsx - Small badge component showing a reason icon + text (e.g., book icon + 'CS 46A', clock icon + '3 shared times').
Create src/components/matches/match-actions.tsx - Action button group: View (eye), Save (bookmark), Skip (x), Chat (message). Maintain save/skip state in the data layer.

Create src/app/(main)/matches/[id]/page.tsx - Match detail page showing: full profile header (avatar, name, major, year, student type), overall compatibility score with circular progress visual, full scoring breakdown table (each category with points earned / max points and a progress bar), 'Why this match works' section using generateMatchExplanation AI helper, shared classes list with course codes and names, overlapping availability visual (highlighted shared time slots), common interests as tags, career goal comparison side-by-side, complementary skills section, suggested first message using generateConversationStarter, 'Start Chat' primary CTA button.
Create src/components/matches/compatibility-breakdown.tsx - Visual breakdown of all 6 scoring categories with progress bars showing points earned vs max.
Create src/components/matches/shared-availability.tsx - Mini availability grid showing only the overlapping slots between two users.
Create src/components/matches/conversation-starter.tsx - Card showing AI-generated (or template) conversation starter with a 'Use this' button that copies to chat.
Wire up match actions: Save adds to saved list, Skip removes from active matches (but can undo), Chat navigates to create/open a direct conversation with that user.
Implement filtering: filter out blocked users, hidden profiles, and already-skipped users from the matches list.
Handle edge cases: no matches state with friendly illustration/message, sparse profile warning encouraging completion, loading skeleton states.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard shows top matches, recommended pod, upcoming event, and stats for demo user
Matches page lists all compatible students sorted by compatibility score
Each match card displays name, avatar, major, compatibility %, and top 3 reasons
Match detail page shows full breakdown of all 6 scoring categories
Match detail shows shared classes, overlapping availability, and common interests
Conversation starter is generated using template fallback (no API key)
Save/Skip actions update the UI state
Chat button navigates to conversation with that match
Empty states render for no matches scenario
